description.value:
Your eyes empty of ordinary color as you look upon the world through the Force instead. For the duration you see all living creatures haloed in telltale light — light-siders glow blue, dark-siders glow red, and the unaligned glow yellow, the brightness reflecting the strength of their connection to the Force.

You also gain blindsight out to 30 feet, and you have advantage on sight-based Wisdom (Perception) checks made against living creatures within that range.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Universal Powers, Level 2
